statements.t: • Completion of Core Conversion: The Company successfully completed its core system conversion and integration activities in September, positioning the Company to realize anticipated cost savings beginning in the fourth quarter of 2026.
• Capital Outlook: With the completion of the core conversion and substantially all major integration activities, the Company expects to resume excess capital accretion in the fourth quarter of 2026.
The Company expects to have sufficient funds available to meet current commitments in the normal course of business.
The Company manages its capital sources, uses, and expected future needs through its Treasury function and the Asset Liability Committee.
Management will continue evaluating the economic conditions at future reporting periods for triggering events.
